title: Kofei language - Wikipedia
text: Kofei is a Papuan language of the Indonesian province of Papua, on the eastern shore of Cenderawasih Bay. Kofei is lexically similar to the East Geelvink Bay languages and presumably belongs in that family, but is too poorly attested to be sure.

title: East Geelvink Bay languages - Wikipedia
text: The East Geelvink Bay or East Cenderawasih languages are a language family of a dozen Papuan languages along the eastern coast of Geelvink Bay in Indonesian Papua, which is also known as Sarera Bay or Cenderawasih.

title: Kofei language
text: It belongs to the East Geelvink Bay language family and is classified as shifting, with direct evidence suggesting it is primarily used as a first language by adults only. The language, also known as Kifei, lacks institutional support and is not taught in schools, contributing to its endangered status.
